name: Rinse 'N' Repeat

movements.notes: calories; add 2 calories each round for 6 rounds, then max calories for rounds 7-8

origin.summary: An event from the 2022 CrossFit Games. The CrossFit Games are the season's final championship stage, where the qualified field competes across multiple events to crown the Fittest on Earth. Games events are tests first and workouts second — many use loads, formats, or venues no affiliate would program, which is exactly why they make interesting benchmarks.

description: Eight rounds of a short swim and ski-erg calories, the calorie target climbing each round before capping out.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/games/2022/8 (official CrossFit Games event), retrieved 2026-07-09; every 2 minutes for up to 8 rounds
